01.pass: Our ancestors would love everything we've built, except how alone we are in it.
weak: The phone insert in shot 2 is an abstract close-up; a stranger may not read it as a feed.
The mirror tilt and the search play from behind, so posture has to carry the acting at a distance.
The laughter in the last shot is small; the full flat needs more life.
01.final: Native 1080×1920 with real depth of field, hands that can hold and type, walks with planted feet, a proper laugh, and composed music.

captions.4: At the door: someone identical, dust on his feet.
captions.10: He looks for the others. The bedroom is empty.
captions.11: The balcony: a thousand windows, nobody out.
captions.14: He sits down close. The host looks up.

02.pass: People come with needs like company, daylight and being held, and we blame ourselves when a life without them wears us down.
weak: The unboxing and first pose (shots 1 and 2) are hard to read: big wooden forearms fill the frame.
The worker's turn to the office (shot 11) is mostly the back of a head.
In the last shot the full-size colleagues crowd behind the little group, so their leaving together doesn't read yet.
02.final: A closer, cleaner unboxing, a stronger office reveal, and the people's exit staged apart from the windowsill. This one could also be shot for real as stop-motion on a desk.

captions.2: Posed in triumph beside the monitor.
captions.3: Four days, same frame: it sinks.
captions.8: A shiny replacement. Next morning, both slumped.
captions.9: The worker is slumped too. A card falls out of the box.

03.pass: Lying awake on guard is an old job that was always shared. Alone, nobody takes over.
weak: The sleeping pile at the camp (shot 10), the emotional peak, is a mass of similar wooden limbs.
The door and blind checks are shot from behind, so the hands are hidden and the sound carries the checks.
Getting out of and back into bed has no weight yet.
03.final: Hand-keyed get-up and lie-down with weight, a clearer pile with a readable child and the draped arm framed, bedding that moves, and composed music.

captions.6: …and is on watch at a camp, long ago.
captions.7: Behind the watcher, the band sleeps by the fire.
captions.10: The watcher sleeps in the warm pile.
captions.11: Back in bed. 3:09. Nobody takes over.
captions.12: About to get up again. A ping.
captions.13: A neighbour: “I'm awake if you need anything.”

04.pass: We understand why a lonely dog falls apart, but call ourselves broken for the same thing.
weak: The owner's drop onto the sofa (shot 7) has no weight and crops the head.
In the courtyard the dogs are small and trot instead of run.
The morning shots are flat and cool.
04.final: A real run and play in the courtyard, a closer and warmer opening, a heavier sofa drop, and composed music.
